description: Honest base-vs-head verification for a checked-out repo: runs the detected test suite at the base ref and at HEAD and reports the red-first delta (newly failing, newly passing), never raw counts. Refuses a dirty working tree unless asked. Agent-callable surface of `greenlight verify`; run it before and after a fix to prove the fix did the work.

allow_dirty.description: Run even when the working tree has uncommitted changes.

base.description: Base ref for the comparison (default: merge-base with upstream, or origin/main).

dir.description: Repo checkout to verify. Defaults to the server's working directory.

parser.description: Override the result parser (e.g. node:test, pytest).

name: verify
